title: Concept: Yarn lockfile pins a SHA-1 integrity value
description: yarn.lock declares an integrity value that is a SHA-1 digest, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the digest cannot prove that the installed archive is the one the lockfile recorded.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through yarn.lock (npm).
risk: SHA-1 collisions are practical, so the digest cannot prove that the installed archive is the one the lockfile recorded.
